title: Can I BEAT Wizard Chess?
summary: Wizard Chess (indie 'chess roguelike where chess meets wizards'): story intro with the Giant Minotaur 'The Teacher' in a liminal space, then the cloaked tutor 'Cloaky' runs a tournament. You control the Bard (blue, swanky hat; cannot attack) plus recruited units (Alice the dog 0 ATK/6 DEF, Elitis the Merc, guards, rogue, druid, javelin unit) on isometric pixel-art dungeon tiles vs golden enemy units, clearing rooms and ending with a boss fight vs Cloaky. He completes the tutorial chapter.
rules: You control blue units; enemies are golden. Select a unit and move it to any valid tile (highlighted).
Every living thing can be hit only once: a unit that is hit becomes Vulnerable; hit again = dead.
Combat happens at the END of each turn: all your units except the Bard automatically attack all adjacent enemies; an enemy is hit if the combined ATK of adjacent attackers exceeds its DEF.
Enemies do the same; the Bard (your leader) being hit twice = game over. Standing next to enemies is dangerous.
Units have ATK, DEF, star rank and a skill (e.g. lonely enemies lose 1 DEF; Guards can't move but have decent DEF; Poised: gain ATK after moving; Druid: enemies in the same row or column lose 2 DEF).
Clearing a room unlocks doors; rewards/shop paid with skull-face currency between rooms; boss fights at the end (shield orbs).
win_condition: Defeat all enemies in each room; beat the boss (Cloaky) without the Bard being killed.
